data.name: Candice
data.gender_notes: Candice is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'Candida', meaning 'pure' or 'innocent'. This name was popularized by the early Christian saint, Saint Candida of Mantua, who was known for her purity and devotion. The name Candice carries the meaning “Pure, innocent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Candice usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes innocence and purity in spirit
data.etymology: Candice belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, innocent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Candice total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
